source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G05 Guide for Employers in respect of Employment Tax Incentive, Revision 17 s12 p. 8 (roll-over amounts; ETI Act s9)
notes: October 2026: ETI R33 000 against employees tax R25 000; R8 000 is rolled over (s12 p. 8: the excess ETI is carried forward to the next month and becomes its brought-forward amount). November: ETI R1 000, employees tax R4 000: available 8 000 + 1 000 = 9 000, used 4 000, carried 5 000 into December (still inside the September-February period). EMP201 for November: brought forward 8 000, used 4 000, carried forward 5 000, refund nil.
